create.name: Nandhiji
create.bio:
Nandhiji (Adhipen Bose) is a yogi and teacher in the Siddha tradition of Tamil Nadu who now lives and works in the United States. He grew up in Sivakasi in a family of industrialists, studied commerce in Chennai and international business in London, and spent his early adult life in business and family life. A near-death initiation from his first guru turned him towards the Siddhas, and he went on to spend years in austerities and solitary meditation around Arunachala, guided by several Siddha masters.

He teaches what he calls the Mastery of Consciousness: mantra, breath and meditation practices aimed at the clear, wakeful state the yogic texts call turiya, along with his Kalangi Kundalini Yoga sequence and the SivaSivaa guided chakra meditation. In the volume Mastery of Consciousness: Awaken the Inner Prophet he gathers 108 short sutras with images from sacred sites in South India, and his band Turiya Nada records Siddha chants. He leads online initiations and a yearly Maha Shivaratri vigil, makes short films on the temples of Tamil Nadu for his YouTube channel, and has founded the Declaration of Consciousness Movement, World Yogi Day and the CNESS platform for conscious leadership.

courses.title: Mastery of Consciousness Book: Awaken The Inner Prophet (digital)
courses.description: Nandhiji's book in digital form: 108 short sutras on reaching higher states of awareness, a brief account of his own path and more than 120 images from Siddha shrines in South India.

courses.title: SivaSivaa: Siddha Guided Chakra Meditation with Nandhiji
courses.description: A recorded set of guided meditation teachings in the Siddha tradition, moving through the chakras with mantra. Sold as a download.

courses.title: Kalangi Kundalini Yoga: Yoga for the Achiever, Level One Basics
courses.description: His daily yoga sequence for beginners and teachers alike, built on sun salutations, Siddha breathing and mantra. Available on DVD or as a download.

courses.title: Mastery of Consciousness Teachings (Digital Download Bundle)
courses.description: A bundle of his main recordings and texts: the yoga programme, the SivaSivaa meditations, the Arakara chant album, the book and six Siddha Wisdom talks.

courses.title: Mastery of Consciousness Courses
courses.description: Nandhiji's self-paced online courses on Siddha teachings and the states of awareness he calls turiya, hosted on Podia.

free_resources.title: Nandhiji on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer profile, with Siddha chants and guided meditations. The tracks are free to play.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @nandhi108 3.78M subscribers (channel header, 4 Nov 2026); Insight Timer 970 followers (queue entry, read 1 Nov 2026); Instagram @nandhiji108, Facebook, X and TikTok not read (off limits or not opened) → ~3.78M readable → superhero
flags: Tier check: the YouTube header shows 3.78M subscribers, but most recent videos have a few hundred to ~230K views and Insight Timer has under 1k followers; the subscriber figure may be ad-driven. Superhero by the count rule; a human may want to look.
Some channel videos promote CNESS at 'India@100 / Viksit Bharat 2047' events (a government development slogan) and 'India as the Mother of Consciousness'; not used. Not judged partisan, but flagged.
One video title names 'Medicine of Consciousness' (Marundeeswarar temple); not used. A product page says an album 'calibrates in vibrations of enlightenment' on kinesiology scales; not repeated.
Base: Santa Monica is from the business address on his contact page (city only kept); the about page says he is based in the United States.
Email 123@nandhi.com is the published site address (looks like a general inbox).
His book has no ISBN on his site, so it is listed as a digital product (an offering), not as a book.
Podia course page returned an empty storefront to our fetch (no course titles in the HTML); price 'See course page'.
Photos: his site (two) and YouTube avatar; same man (white beard, turban) in all.
left_out: Events: none upcoming (Maha Shivaratri vigil Feb 2026 is past).
YouTube: CNESS / India@100 promos, Shorts under ~2 minutes, the 'Medicine of Consciousness' temple video.
Siddha Wisdom MP3s ($3.99 each): covered by the bundle.
Mastery of Consciousness: Awaken the Inner Prophet as a book: no ISBN found.
